subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command now, fold fallback-chain testing into the broader `models status --probe --all` health-check work, or defer it to staged model migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this creates a new live model-diagnostics command that overlaps existing auth probes and open model migration/health-check requests, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with an optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make the broader configured-model health-check work own fallback-chain probing and add slash-command discoverability only if maintainers want that UX.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in a staged model migration workflow instead of adding a standalone command now.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with an optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

likelyOwner.reason: He already supplied issue-specific guidance and has recent history on the overlapping model-status probe and fallback command surfaces.
